topic: Promo: a skeptic says one line cannot make a finished video, and each pipeline stage proves it wrong
title: ONE TOPIC LINE
A FINISHED VIDEO

script.text: You say one line cannot make a finished video.
Fine. Watch one topic line go in.
Claude writes the script, shot list, cuts and sound plan.
Then a voice records every line.
Every frame is drawn in code and rendered.
The audio is mixed and mastered.
Now you watch the finished video.
Bring your own voice and writing keys. None are included.
Get the system. Link in the about section.

science.claim: A finished video cannot come from one line of text.
science.working: A claim voiced by the skeptic character, not a fact. The episode answers it stage by stage. No figure.
The pipeline takes a single topic line as its input.

science.claim: Claude writes the script, shot list, cuts and sound plan.
science.working: Four written outputs: script, shot list, cuts, sound plan. Counted from the brief, no other figure.
One voice call per script line, as the voice step does.
science.source: skill brief, what the VM does

science.claim: Every frame is drawn in code and rendered.
science.working: Shots are code, each a pure function of its clock, rendered to frames.

science.claim: The audio is mixed and mastered.
science.working: Sound step places events, master step levels the final mix. No figure stated.
science.source: skill brief, what the VM does

science.claim: You bring your own voice and writing keys. None are included.
science.working: Two keys, voice and writing, both supplied by the buyer. Zero are included.
Call to action points to the about section only. No link, number or handle is written.
science.source: skill brief, call to action rule
